Manhattan Plot for Genome-Wide and Microbial Association Studies

Source: R/type_manhattan.R
type_manhattan.Rd

Creates publication-ready Manhattan plots for host GWAS and microbial genome-wide association studies (mGWAS). Supports multi-chromosome genomic layouts with alternating chromosome hues and centered axis labels, as well as single-contig microbial chromosomes. Includes customizable significance threshold lines, hit highlighting, and automatic gene/variant labeling.

Usage

type_manhattan(
  threshold = 0.05,
  is_already_log10 = FALSE,
  point_size = 1.2,
  point_alpha = 0.85,
  chr_colors = c("#2B5C8F", "#82B0D2"),
  highlight_color = "#E64B35",
  threshold_color = "#888888",
  threshold_linetype = "dashed",
  label_hits = TRUE,
  label_col = NULL,
  max_overlaps = 25,
  xlab = NULL,
  ylab = NULL
)

Arguments

threshold

Significance cutoff. For raw p-values or q-values, defaults to 0.05 (or 5e-8 for genome-wide significance). For data already on the -log10 scale, specifies the vertical line position.

is_already_log10

Logical. If TRUE, the y-axis values are assumed to already be \(-\log_{10}(p)\) or \(-\log_{10}(q)\). Default FALSE.

point_size

Size of variant points (default 1.2).

point_alpha

Opacity of variant points (default 0.85).

chr_colors

Character vector of two alternating colors for chromosomes (default c("#2B5C8F", "#82B0D2")).

highlight_color

Color for variants exceeding the significance threshold (default "#E64B35").

threshold_color

Color for the horizontal significance line (default "#888888").

threshold_linetype

Line type for the threshold line (default "dashed").

label_hits

Logical. If TRUE, annotates significant variants exceeding the threshold with text labels. Default TRUE.

label_col

Column name or character vector containing variant or gene labels. If NULL, auto-detects columns named "label", "gene", "snp", or "hit".

max_overlaps

Maximum overlapping labels allowed by ggrepel (default 25).

xlab

Label for x-axis. Defaults to "Chromosome" for multi-chromosome or "Chromosome position (bp)" for single-contig genomes.

ylab

Label for y-axis (default expression(-log[10]~italic(p))).

Value

A cliplot_type object for use with cliplot.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Simulated microbial GWAS data
set.seed(42)
mgwas_df <- data.frame(
  pos = seq(1000, 500000, by = 5000),
  qvalue = c(runif(95, 0.05, 1.0), runif(5, 1e-5, 0.01)),
  gene = c(rep("", 95), paste0("mut_", 1:5))
)

cliplot(qvalue ~ pos, data = mgwas_df,
        type = type_manhattan(threshold = 0.05, label_col = "gene"))
} # }
